candidates.description: This feature vector represents morphological roots, prefixes, and phonetic components associated with the Latin-derived root 'per-' across Romance languages.
These tokens represent historical American city names, particularly those with British colonial or early U.S. roots.
This vector represents Spanish verbs in their infinitive form.
This vector represents adjectives and verbs describing intensity, importance, or difficulty across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents geographical entities, nationalities, and proper nouns related to Western countries and continents.
This vector activates on common Portuguese words and morphemes.
This feature vector activates on geographic locations such as countries, counties, islands, and coastal regions.
This feature vector represents morphological suffixes and roots characteristic of verb conjugations in Romance languages.
This vector represents linguistic root morphemes, proper noun fragments, and vocabulary stems across multiple Romance and Germanic languages.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to historical, geographical, and dynastic proper nouns or words starting with continental prefixes and related stems.
